'''Lok Trul''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Gamorr system/Legends|Opoku system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Galov sector/Legends|Galov sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Opoku]] and had thirteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], Lok Trul was located along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lok Trul was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the Opoku system, and therefore Lok Trul, in grid square T-14.<ref name="TEA" />
